name: obix-monorepo
description: OBIX 1.0 — DOP-Native Component Language. Monorepo for the twenty obix-* public packages.
author: OBINexus Computing — Nnamdi Michael Okpala <obinexusmk2@proton.me>

scripts.check:suite: npm run build:suite && npm run test:suite
scripts.build:adapters: npm run build --workspace adapters/obix-adapter-oop --workspace adapters/obix-adapter-reactive --workspace adapters/obix-adapter-ssr
scripts.build:primitives: npm run build --workspace primitives/obix-component-button --workspace primitives/obix-component-card --workspace primitives/obix-component-image --workspace primitives/obix-component-video --workspace primitives/obix-component-link
scripts.build:overlays: npm run build --workspace overlays/obix-component-modal --workspace overlays/obix-component-dropdown --workspace overlays/obix-component-tooltip
